# healthchecks_project (Resource)

Manages a Healthchecks project. Project operations use authenticated web endpoints, and the provider ensures a read-write project API key exists for downstream API usage.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `api_key_enabled` (Boolean)
- `ping_key_enabled` (Boolean)
- `read_only_api_key_enabled` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ping_key` (String, Sensitive)
- `read_only_api_key` (String, Sensitive)
